WITH StationMax AS (
  SELECT station_id, MAX(CAST(temperature AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS max_temp
  FROM weather_observations
  WHERE observation_date LIKE '2023%'
  GROUP BY station_id
),
TargetObs AS (
  SELECT wo.obs_id, wo.station_id, wo.temperature, wo.temperature_unit, wo.observation_date
  FROM weather_observations wo
  JOIN StationMax sm ON wo.station_id = sm.station_id AND CAST(wo.temperature AS DECIMAL(10,2)) = sm.max_temp
  WHERE wo.observation_date LIKE '2023%'
),
TopUsers AS (
  SELECT al.obs_id, u.user_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY al.obs_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM access_logs al
  JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id
  GROUP BY al.obs_id, u.user_name
)
SELECT ws.station_name, t.temperature, t.temperature_unit, t.observation_date, tu.user_name
FROM TargetObs t
JOIN weather_stations ws ON t.station_id = ws.station_id
LEFT JOIN TopUsers tu ON t.obs_id = tu.obs_id AND tu.rnk = 1
ORDER BY CAST(t.temperature AS DECIMAL(10,2)) DESC

SELECT T1.company_name, T1.ticker, T1.ceo_name, T1.headquarters_location, T1.founded_year, T1.website, T3.industry_name, T4.year, T4.quarter, T4.revenue, T5.mkt_cap, T5.ind_rev, T5.percent_tot_rev, (SELECT COUNT(access_id) FROM access_logs WHERE company_id = T1.company_id) AS access_count FROM companies AS T1 JOIN company_industries AS T2 ON T1.company_id = T2.company_id JOIN industries AS T3 ON T2.industry_id = T3.industry_id JOIN revenue_distribution AS T4 ON T1.company_id = T4.company_id JOIN historical_data AS T5 ON T1.company_id = T5.company_id AND T4.quarter = T5.quarter AND CAST(SUBSTR(T5.date, 1, 4) AS SIGNED) = T4.year WHERE T1.active_status = 1 AND T4.year >= 2018

SELECT T1.title, AVG(T2.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.review_id) AS number_of_reviews, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.award_id) AS number_of_awards, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T5.name) AS directors FROM movies AS T1 JOIN reviews AS T2 ON T1.movie_id = T2.movie_id LEFT JOIN awards AS T3 ON T1.movie_id = T3.movie_id LEFT JOIN movie_directors AS T4 ON T1.movie_id = T4.movie_id LEFT JOIN directors AS T5 ON T4.director_id = T5.director_id GROUP BY T1.movie_id, T1.title HAVING AVG(T2.rating) >= 4 ORDER BY average_rating DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT mc.campaign_id, mc.campaign_name, COALESCE(eng.engagement_rate, 0) AS engagement_rate, COALESCE(sls.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(sls.avg_recommendation_strength, 0) AS avg_recommendation_strength FROM marketing_campaigns AS mc LEFT JOIN (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN engagement_status = 'Engaged' THEN customer_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0) AS engagement_rate FROM campaign_customers GROUP BY campaign_id) AS eng ON mc.campaign_id = eng.campaign_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ci.campaign_id, SUM(ti.quantity * ti.item_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ar.rule_strength) AS avg_recommendation_strength FROM campaign_items AS ci LEFT JOIN transaction_items AS ti ON ci.item_id = ti.item_id LEFT JOIN association_rules AS ar ON CAST(ci.item_id AS CHAR) = ar.antecedent_items GROUP BY ci.campaign_id) AS sls ON mc.campaign_id = sls.campaign_id ORDER BY engagement_rate DESC, total_sales DESC, avg_recommendation_strength DESC

SELECT stats.team_name, stats.first_name, stats.last_name, stats.season, team_maxes.max_team_score, stats.personal_best FROM (SELECT t.team_name, t.team_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, YEAR(m.match_date) AS season, MAX(s.final_score) AS personal_best FROM scores AS s JOIN matches AS m ON s.match_id = m.match_id JOIN teams AS t ON s.team_id = t.team_id JOIN players AS p ON s.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name, p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, season) AS stats JOIN (SELECT s2.team_id, YEAR(m2.match_date) AS season, MAX(s2.final_score) AS max_team_score FROM scores AS s2 JOIN matches AS m2 ON s2.match_id = m2.match_id GROUP BY s2.team_id, season) AS team_maxes ON stats.team_id = team_maxes.team_id AND stats.season = team_maxes.season WHERE stats.personal_best = team_maxes.max_team_score ORDER BY stats.season, stats.team_name

WITH SelectionCounts AS (SELECT apartment_id, COUNT(*) AS selection_count FROM user_actions WHERE action_type = 'selection' GROUP BY apartment_id), CityInterest AS (SELECT l.city, AVG(CAST(a.interest_level AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_interest_level FROM apartments a JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY l.city), RankedApartments AS (SELECT a.building_name, a.apartment_id, CAST(a.views AS UNSIGNED) AS view_count, COALESCE(s.selection_count, 0) AS selection_count, ci.avg_interest_level, l.city, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.city ORDER BY CAST(a.views AS UNSIGNED) DESC) AS view_rank FROM apartments a JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id JOIN CityInterest ci ON l.city = ci.city LEFT JOIN SelectionCounts s ON a.apartment_id = s.apartment_id) SELECT building_name, apartment_id, view_count, selection_count, avg_interest_level FROM RankedApartments WHERE view_rank <= 5 ORDER BY city, view_rank

WITH RECURSIVE category_paths AS (SELECT category_id, CAST(category_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS full_category_path FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL OR parent_category_id = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, CONCAT(cp.full_category_path, ' > ', c.category_name) FROM categories c JOIN category_paths cp ON CAST(c.parent_category_id AS UNSIGNED) = cp.category_id), review_stats AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(review_id) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM product_reviews GROUP BY product_id), inventory_stats AS (SELECT s.product_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_inventory FROM skus s LEFT JOIN inventory i ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id GROUP BY s.product_id) SELECT p.description, p.price, p.weight, p.material, p.color, p.size, p.style, COALESCE(rs.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(rs.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(is_stats.total_inventory, 0) AS total_inventory, b.brand_name, cp.full_category_path FROM products p LEFT JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN category_paths cp ON p.category_id = cp.category_id LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON p.product_id = rs.product_id LEFT JOIN inventory_stats is_stats ON p.product_id = is_stats.product_id ORDER BY average_rating DESC, total_inventory DESC, p.price ASC

SELECT c.config_id, c.connector, c.rows_per_second, c.number_of_rows, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.description, c.is_active, u.username, u.email, u.role_id, COALESCE(l.log_count, 0) AS log_count, COALESCE(l.avg_duration, 0) AS avg_duration, COALESCE(l.total_duration, 0) AS total_duration, COALESCE(d.dataset_count, 0) AS dataset_count, COALESCE(d.total_size, 0) AS total_size, COALESCE(d.avg_quality_score, 0) AS avg_quality_score, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(d.avg_quality_score, 0)) AS quality_score_percentile FROM data_generation_configs c JOIN users u ON c.created_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT config_id, COUNT(log_id) AS log_count, AVG(CAST(duration AS DECIMAL(15,4))) AS avg_duration, SUM(CAST(duration AS DECIMAL(15,4))) AS total_duration FROM data_generation_logs GROUP BY config_id) l ON c.config_id = l.config_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT config_id, COUNT(dataset_id) AS dataset_count, SUM(CAST(size_in_bytes AS UNSIGNED)) AS total_size, AVG(quality_score) AS avg_quality_score FROM generated_datasets GROUP BY config_id) d ON c.config_id = d.config_id ORDER BY total_duration DESC, quality_score_percentile DESC

WITH RECURSIVE region_path AS (SELECT region_id, region_name, parent_region_id, CAST(region_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS path FROM geographic_regions WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT r.region_id, r.region_name, r.parent_region_id, CONCAT(rp.path, ' > ', r.region_name) FROM geographic_regions r JOIN region_path rp ON r.parent_region_id = rp.region_id), active_counts AS (SELECT rd.region_id, COUNT(*) AS active_dataset_count FROM region_dataset rd JOIN datasets d ON rd.dataset_id = d.dataset_id WHERE d.is_active = 1 GROUP BY rd.region_id) SELECT rp.region_name, rp.path, COALESCE(ac.active_dataset_count, 0) AS active_datasets FROM region_path rp LEFT JOIN active_counts ac ON rp.region_id = ac.region_id ORDER BY rp.path

SELECT T1.customer_id, COUNT(T1.interaction_id), GROUP_CONCAT(T2.employee_name) FROM customer_interactions AS T1 JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.employee_id = T2.employee_id WHERE T1.interaction_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY T1.customer_id HAVING COUNT(T1.interaction_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.interaction_id) DESC

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name, ep.avg_rating, et.training_list, COALESCE(ha.hr_access_count, 0) AS hr_access_count FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id JOIN (SELECT employee_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM performance_reviews GROUP BY employee_id) ep ON e.employee_id = ep.employee_id JOIN (SELECT e2.department_id, AVG(pr2.rating) AS dept_avg_rating FROM performance_reviews pr2 JOIN employees e2 ON pr2.employee_id = e2.employee_id GROUP BY e2.department_id) dp ON e.department_id = dp.department_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT et2.employee_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(tp.training_name, ' (', et2.completion_date, ', ', et2.rating, ')') SEPARATOR '; ') AS training_list FROM employee_training et2 JOIN training_programs tp ON et2.training_id = tp.training_id GROUP BY et2.employee_id) et ON e.employee_id = et.employee_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT al.employee_id, COUNT(*) AS hr_access_count FROM access_logs al JOIN users u ON al.access_by = u.user_id WHERE u.role = 'HR' GROUP BY al.employee_id) ha ON e.employee_id = ha.employee_id WHERE ep.avg_rating > dp.dept_avg_rating

WITH RECURSIVE employee_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT 
    employee_id, 
    employee_name, 
    manager_id, 
    CAST(years_at_company AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS years, 
    performance_rating, 
    department, 
    location_id, 
    1 AS level, 
    CAST(employee_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS name_path
  FROM employees
  WHERE manager_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    e.employee_id, 
    e.employee_name, 
    e.manager_id, 
    CAST(e.years_at_company AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 
    e.performance_rating, 
    e.department, 
    e.location_id, 
    eh.level + 1, 
    CONCAT(eh.name_path, ' -> ', e.employee_name)
  FROM employees e
  JOIN employee_hierarchy eh ON e.manager_id = eh.employee_id
)
SELECT 
  eh.employee_id, 
  eh.employee_name, 
  eh.years, 
  eh.performance_rating, 
  eh.level, 
  eh.name_path, 
  l.location_name, 
  l.city, 
  l.state, 
  l.country, 
  eh.department, 
  r.rating_balance, 
  SUM(eh.performance_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY eh.department ORDER BY eh.years DESC) AS cumulative_performance
FROM employee_hierarchy eh
JOIN locations l ON eh.location_id = l.location_id
LEFT JOIN ratings r ON eh.employee_id = r.review_id
ORDER BY eh.department, eh.years DESC;

)

WITH ranked_outbreaks AS (SELECT outbreak_id, etiology_id, total_cases, outbreak_year, location_id, start_date, end_date, status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outbreak_year ORDER BY total_cases DESC) AS outbreak_rank FROM outbreaks) SELECT ro.outbreak_id, e.name, ro.total_cases, ro.outbreak_year, l.location_name, l.city, l.state, l.country, ro.start_date, ro.end_date, ro.status, f.factor_description, f.category, i.intervention_type, i.effectiveness, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interventions i2 WHERE i2.outbreak_id = ro.outbreak_id) AS intervention_count, ro.outbreak_rank FROM ranked_outbreaks AS ro JOIN etiologies AS e ON ro.etiology_id = e.etiology_id JOIN locations AS l ON ro.location_id = l.location_id LEFT JOIN outbreak_factors AS ofa ON ro.outbreak_id = ofa.outbreak_id LEFT JOIN factors AS f ON ofa.factor_id = f.factor_id LEFT JOIN interventions AS i ON ro.outbreak_id = i.outbreak_id ORDER BY ro.outbreak_year, ro.total_cases DESC

SELECT T1.player_name, T2.round, T2.match_date, T2.score, T3.total_aces, T4.rank, T4.points FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player1_id JOIN tournaments AS T5 ON T2.tournament_id = T5.tournament_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT player_id, SUM(stat_value) AS total_aces FROM statistics WHERE stat_type = 'aces' GROUP BY player_id) AS T3 ON T1.player_id = T3.player_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r1.player_id, r1.rank, r1.points FROM rankings r1 WHERE r1.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM rankings r2 WHERE r2.player_id = r1.player_id)) AS T4 ON T1.player_id = T4.player_id WHERE T5.tournament_code = 'WIM' ORDER BY T2.match_date ASC

SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p2.project_name AS parent_project_name, l.location_name, it.incentive_type_name, p.projected_state_tax_revenue, p.actual_state_tax_revenue, (CAST(p.actual_state_tax_revenue AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(p.projected_state_tax_revenue AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS tax_revenue_variance, p.projected_jobs, p.actual_jobs_created, (p.actual_jobs_created - p.projected_jobs) AS jobs_variance, p.projected_capital_investment, p.actual_capital_investment, (CAST(p.actual_capital_investment AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(p.projected_capital_investment AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS capital_investment_variance, pm.metric_name, pm.metric_value FROM projects p LEFT JOIN projects p2 ON p.project_manager_id = p2.project_id JOIN locations l ON p.location_id = l.location_id JOIN incentive_types it ON p.incentive_type_id = it.incentive_type_id LEFT JOIN project_metrics pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id ORDER BY p.project_id, p.project_name

SELECT T1.school_name, T2.avg_critical_reading, T2.avg_math, T2.avg_writing, T2.num_test_takers, T4.description, T4.status FROM schools AS T1 JOIN sat_scores AS T2 ON T1.school_id = T2.school_id JOIN performance_reports AS T3 ON T1.school_id = T3.school_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT school_id, description, status FROM (SELECT school_id, description, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY school_id ORDER BY date_initiated DESC) AS rn FROM interventions) AS sub WHERE rn <= 3) AS T4 ON T1.school_id = T4.school_id WHERE T3.report_status = 'draft' ORDER BY T1.school_name

generated_sql: SELECT T1.project_name, T3.dataset_name, T2.model_name, T2.version, T2.training_accuracy, AVG(T4.test_accuracy) FROM projects AS T1 JOIN models AS T2 ON T1.project_id = T2.project_id JOIN datasets AS T3 ON T2.dataset_id = T3.dataset_id JOIN folds AS T4 ON T2.model_id = T4.model_id GROUP BY T1.project_id, T1.project_name, T3.dataset_name, T2.model_name, T2.version, T2.training_accuracy ORDER BY T1.project_id

SELECT t.legislation_name, AVG(cf.amount_supported) AS average_financial_support, AVG(cf.amount_opposed) AS average_financial_opposition, t.yes_votes, t.no_votes, t.not_voting_votes FROM (SELECT legislation_id, legislation_name, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Not Voting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_voting_votes FROM voting_records WHERE vote_date LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY legislation_id, legislation_name ORDER BY ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC LIMIT 1) AS t JOIN voting_records AS v ON t.legislation_id = v.legislation_id LEFT JOIN campaign_financing AS cf ON v.candidate_id = cf.candidate_id AND cf.year = 2022 GROUP BY t.legislation_id, t.legislation_name, t.yes_votes, t.no_votes, t.not_voting_votes

SELECT T1.feedback_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(T4.user_name, ', ', T3.access_date, ', ', T3.action_taken, ', ', T3.notes) SEPARATOR '; ') AS user_notes FROM feedback_aspects AS T1 JOIN aspects AS T2 ON T1.aspect_id = T2.aspect_id JOIN feedback_access AS T3 ON T1.feedback_id = T3.feedback_id JOIN users AS T4 ON T3.user_id = T4.user_id WHERE T2.aspect_term = 'human interface' GROUP BY T1.feedback_id
